item.description: Broken, not dead: Hermphon #4519 (the stone in their midst (House of Echion)). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.description: The fire under Chthongenes Menphonides ~1143 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.
